name: fleet-publish-archive-commit-retry
title: fleet-publish: no retry around task.py archive auto-commit
description: In fleet-publish.py, archive_and_journal() calls task.py archive, whose _auto_commit_archive (common/task_store.py) runs 'git commit' with no retry. During the 0.64.4 self-publish a transient .git/index.lock contention made that commit return non-zero, so task.py printed 'Archive moved on disk, but git auto-commit did not complete' and exited 1; the helper aborted mid-run with the task already moved on disk (H1 committed, archive staged-but-uncommitted), requiring manual recovery. A bare 'git commit' succeeded immediately on retry, confirming it was transient lock contention (likely a background indexer/hook). Scope (revised after 3-round adversarial review, M-1): the task_store retry is OUT of this pack release (common/task_store.py is Trellis-owned, not shipped by the pack; README forbids patching it here) and is handed upstream as 08-04-trellis-upstream-archive-commit-lock-retry. This child ships ONLY the pack-owned half: on a consumer, fleet-publish fails loudly with recovery guidance instead of an incomplete dir-only rollback (cmd_archive also mutates status/children/sessions pre-move — N-1).
